name: EMail
welcome: Welcome to **EMail**, e-mail for the Atari ST, STE, TT and Falcon. It reads your mail from IMAP or POP3 servers, sends it over SMTP, keeps a copy of your IMAP folders on disk so you can read offline, and reads and writes Hebrew.

window.title: The main window
items: [[Folders]]: your mailboxes. Drag a message onto one to move it.
Messages: the folder's list. A click shows a message below.
Reading: the message chosen, quoted lines in colour.

diagram.title: How EMail reaches your mail
diagram.round: [[Falcon mode]]: a Falcon or TT does TLS itself
after: Most providers want an encrypted connection. A Raspberry Pi on your network can do it for any Atari (see [[The Raspberry Pi gateway]]), or a Falcon or TT can do it itself.
